newsitem.title: FINLAND: Orion sees manifold Hygicult sales.
newsitem.headline: Orion sees manifold Hygicult sales.

text.p: Tighter hygiene control laws in the EU and U.S. will increase manifold demand for Finnish pharmaceuticals group Orion-yhtyma Oy's hygiene control product range Hygicult, Orion Diagnostica's president Matti Vaheri said.
In an interview with Reuters on Wednesday, Vaheri said the new laws would start coming into force next year, helping the group boost sales of the over ten-year-old product range.
"Sales of this product will certainly increase manifold," Vaheri said.

Vaheri said Hygicult products are "significant" for his division which accounted for 201 million markka or five percent of Orion's 1995 net sales but he declined to give the products' current sales figures.
Hygicult products help find general bacteria, yeasts and fungi in various environments and Vaheri said they are the leading dip-slide products on their kind.
